method.tf: multitaper DPSS 1 s window NW=1.5 (2 tapers), 0.25 s hop, 1-Hz bins 4-45 Hz, dB; values on a 0.5 s grid pool frames within +-0.5 s (support tau-1..tau+1 s)
method.baseline: local, mean of -10..-2 s before each onset, per channel x frequency
method.cleaning: eegbci.brainonly: Fp1/Fp2/F7/F8 excluded; frames overlapping blinks +-0.5 s excluded; label-free regression of VEOG, HEOG (F7-F8, FT9-FT10), temporal EMG 30-45 Hz, neck EMG 55-70 Hz out of every channel x freq
method.stats: mne permutation_cluster_1samp_test over time x freq x 26 channels (Delaunay adjacency), t with hat sigma=1e-3, cluster-forming p<0.05 two-tailed, 2048 permutations (exact sign-flip enumeration when 2^n <= 2048), tested window 0..25 s (offsets 0..18 s)
